export const ALLOCATED_REMINDER_SEARCH_OPTIONS = [
  { id: "due_month", name: "Due Month", type: "current_date_month" },
  { id: "allocated_pic", name: "Allocated PIC", type: "autocomplete_user" },
  { id: "allocate_activity", name: "Allocated Activity", type: "autocomplete_activity" },
  { id: "assigned_date", name: "Assigned Date", type: "date" },
  // { id: "ids", name: "Application ID", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "partner_application_id", name: "Partner ID", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "pic", name: "PIC", type: "autocomplete_user" },
  { id: "is_mnet_assigned", name: "Is Mnet Assigned?", type: "autocomplete_is_true_false" },
  { id: "applicant_name", name: "Applicant Name", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "nrc", name: "Applicant NRC", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "date_of_birth", name: "Date of Birth", type: "date" },
  { id: "contact_date", name: "Contact Date", type: "date" },
  { id: "promised_date", name: "Promise Date", type: "date" },
  { id: "follow_up_result", name: "Follow Up Result", type: "autocomplete_follow_up_result" },
  { id: "promise", name: "Today Promised Accounts?", type: "autocomplete_is_true" },
  { id: "no_promise", name: "Today No Promised Accounts?", type: "autocomplete_is_true" },
  { id: "no_activities", name: "Today No Activities Accounts?", type: "autocomplete_is_true" },
  { id: "category_id", name: "Category", type: "autocomplete_category" },
  { id: "sub_category_id", name: "Sub Category", type: "autocomplete_sub_category" },
  { id: "loan_amount", name: "Loan Amount", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "partner_address_township", name: "Partner Township", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "customer_category", name: "Customer Category", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "region", name: "Region", type: "autocomplete_state" },
  { id: "commencement_date", name: "Disbursed Date", type: "date" },
  { id: "first_due_date", name: "First Due Date", type: "date" },
  { id: "due_date", name: "Due Date", type: "date" },
  { id: "finance_term", name: "Finance Term", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "tenor", name: "Tenor", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "monthly_installment_amount", name: "Monthly Installment Amount", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "total_outstanding_amount", name: "Total Outstanding Amount", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "collection_fees", name: "Collection Fees", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "collected_collection_fees", name: "Collected Collection Fees", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "last_payment_date", name: "Last Payment Date", type: "date" },
  { id: "last_payment_amount", name: "Last Payment Amount", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "overdue_amount", name: "Overdue Amount", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "overdue_days", name: "Overdue Days", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "status_array", name: "Contract Status", type: "autocomplete_status" },
  { id: "overdue_status", name: "Overdue Status", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "living_phone_number", name: "Living Phone Number(Customer)", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "viber_number", name: "Viber Number(Customer)", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "residence_status", name: "Residence Status", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "reference_name", name: "Reference Name", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "reference_relation_with_customer", name: "Relation with Customer(Reference)", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "reference_phone", name: "Reference Phone", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "guarantor_name", name: "Guarantor Name", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "guarantor_relation_with_customer", name: "Relation with Customer(Guarantor)", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "guarantor_primary_ph", name: "Guarantor Primary Ph", type: "text_field" },
  { id: "created_by", name: "Created By", type: "autocomplete_user" },
  { id: "modified_by", name: "Modified By", type: "autocomplete_user" },
  { id: "created_date", name: "Created Date", type: "date" },
  { id: "modified_date", name: "Modified Date", type: "date" },
];
